15"""GCU400-specific scalar overloads of _foreach_minimum / _foreach_minimum_. 

16 

17The common foreach executor carries the tensor list in a 2D grid, and GCU400's ``grid.y`` 

18limit of 255 causes ``out of resource`` on large shapes. Contiguous float lists use the 

191D fixed grid / metadata fused kernel from ``_foreach_flat``; non-float, 

20non-contiguous or broadcast shapes still delegate to the common executor to keep dtype policy and exception semantics. 

21 

22The paired ``.List`` path runs its own single-launch kernel (``_minimum_list_kernel``): 

23same four-segment int64 metadata and ``(tensor, part)`` linearization as the common 

24``fused_binary_list_kernel``, with two GCU400-specific refinements measured on the 

25official do_bench kernel protocol (fresh stack re-anchor, jobs/j20261119081737): 

26 

27* the grid is an exact multiple of the tensor count by construction (see 

28 ``_minimum_grid``), so every tile of every tensor is covered for any list 

29 length -- ``_foreach_flat._fused_grid`` caps by ``min(fixed_grid, NT*tiles)`` 

30 and left the tiles of the trailing ``grid % NT`` tensors unvisited for list 

31 lengths that do not divide the cap; 

32* ``EXACT`` drops the per-tile bounds mask when every element count divides 

33 the chosen ``BLOCK``, and the block is tiered by dtype: fp32 stays at 8192, 

34 16-bit moves to 16384. On this stack EXACT@8192 wins for fp32 (-17/-11/-5% 

35 at 256^2/512^2/1024^2) while for bf16 the same 8192 tile *regresses* 

36 (+2~3%) and only the 16384 tile turns the mask removal into a win -- the 

37 (dtype, tile) coupling first measured on ``_foreach_maximum_List`` 

38 reproduces here. Ragged lists keep the shipped masked 8192 body. 

39""" 

40 

41import logging 

42 

43import torch 

44import triton 

45import triton.language as tl 

46 

47from flag_gems.ops._foreach_binary import _apply_list, _apply_scalar 

48from flag_gems.utils import libentry 

49from flag_gems.utils.foreach import _device_meta 

50 

51from ._foreach_flat import ( 

52 _TL_DTYPES, 

53 FALLBACK, 

54 MODE_LIST, 

55 MODE_SCALAR, 

56 MODE_SCALAR_LIST, 

57 OP_MIN, 

58 can_use_flat, 

59 fused_binary_scalar_kernel, 

60 run_binary, 

61) 

62 

63logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

64 

65# Output allocation is on the per-call host path of a list op (16 tensors => 16 calls), and the 

66# python-level ``torch.empty_like`` goes through the torch_gcu argument-translation shim on every 

67# call. The aten form is the same allocation without that shim; both preserve shape/dtype/device/ 

68# memory-format, so the output layout is bit-identical to ``torch.empty_like``. 

69_EMPTY_LIKE = torch.ops.aten.empty_like.default 

70 

71# --- TUNING PARAMS START --- 

72# Generated by the optimization-iteration driver per round; all of it is compile/launch-time 

73# config and never changes operator semantics. 

74# Official do_bench kernel-mode (w1000/r100 median) kernel-only variant sweep 

75# (Triton GCU 4.1.6, jobs/j20261119081737 fresh re-anchor): 

76# * EXACT mask-free is coupled to (dtype, tile) (maximum_List precedent reproduced on this stack): 

77# fp32 uses 8192 (-17/-11/-5% @256^2/512^2/1024^2) and 16384 ties with it; 

78# 16-bit uses 16384 (fp16 -5%/-4%, bf16 -4%), while 8192+EXACT regresses bf16 

79# (+2~3% on the 512^2/1024^2 tiers); 

80# * when any tensor element count does not divide the chosen BLOCK the whole table falls back 

81# to 8192+mask (shipped behavior, bit-identical); 

82# * the grid is always a multiple of the tensor count (_minimum_grid); at nt=16 it is the same 

83# 48 programs as the old _fused_grid, and the tail-tensor write hole is fixed for other lengths; 

84# * num_warps 8 and 4 are identical tier by tier (same addcmul family precedent), and the backend 

85# does not pipeline this tile loop, so num_stages stays 1. 

86# Program-count budget handed to ``_minimum_grid`` (a 16-tensor list yields 3 parts per tensor = 48 

87# programs); it must stay a multiple of the tensor count so every tensor gets the same number of parts. 

88FIXED_GRID = 48 

89BLOCK_SIZE = 8192 

90BLOCK_SIZE_16BIT = 16384 

91NUM_WARPS = 4 

92NUM_STAGES = 1 

93USE_DEVICE_CONTEXT = 0 

94FP32_PROMOTE = 0 

95FUSED_LAUNCH = 1 

96FALLBACK_TO_PUBLIC = 0 

97# When every numel divides the chosen BLOCK, take the mask-free EXACT kernel variant (decided 

98# after BLOCK is picked per dtype); any non-divisible tensor puts the whole batch on the mask path. 

99USE_EXACT = 1 

100# All overloads reuse the _device_meta read-only cache, removing the steady-state synchronous H2D. 

101USE_META_CACHE = 1 

102# The fp32 scalar table for .ScalarList is cached separately by (device, value). 

103USE_SCALAR_CACHE = 1 

104SCALAR_CACHE_LIMIT = 64 

105# --- TUNING PARAMS END --- 

106 

107# Read-only metadata cache: the key contains only device and address/element count, not tensor data; the kernel still 

108# fully reads inputs and recomputes each time, so address reuse or in-place content changes do not affect correctness. 

109_SCALAR_CACHE = {} 

110 

111 

112@libentry() 

113@triton.jit 

114def _minimum_list_kernel( 

115 meta_ptr, 

116 NT: tl.constexpr, 

117 A_DT: tl.constexpr, 

118 FP32_PROMOTE: tl.constexpr, 

119 BLOCK: tl.constexpr, 

120 EXACT: tl.constexpr, 

121): 

122 """``.List`` minimum: one launch handles the whole paired tensor list. 

123 

124 ``meta_ptr`` holds input pointers, output pointers, second-operand pointers and element 

125 counts in order (NT items each, int64). grid.x is linearized by ``(tensor, part)`` and is a 

126 multiple of NT by construction (see ``_minimum_grid``). It mirrors the shared 

127 ``fused_binary_list_kernel`` with two differences: OP is fixed to minimum (dropping the 

128 compile-time dispatch chain), and ``EXACT`` skips the per-tile bounds mask when every 

129 element count divides ``BLOCK`` -- under the official do_bench kernel protocol the mask 

130 predicate is the main kernel-side cost on small shapes. 

131 """ 

132 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

133 num_programs = tl.num_programs(0) 

134 tensor_id = pid % NT 

135 part_id = pid // NT 

136 num_parts = tl.cdiv(num_programs, NT) 

137 

138 a_raw = tl.load(meta_ptr + tensor_id) 

139 out_raw = tl.load(meta_ptr + NT + tensor_id) 

140 b_raw = tl.load(meta_ptr + 2 * NT + tensor_id) 

141 num_elems = tl.load(meta_ptr + 3 * NT + tensor_id) 

142 

143 a_ptr = a_raw.to(tl.pointer_type(A_DT)) 

144 out_ptr = out_raw.to(tl.pointer_type(A_DT)) 

145 b_ptr = b_raw.to(tl.pointer_type(A_DT)) 

146 

147 arange = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

148 num_tiles = tl.cdiv(num_elems, BLOCK) 

149 for block_id in tl.range(part_id, num_tiles, num_parts): 

150 offs = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

151 if EXACT: 

152 a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs) 

153 b = tl.load(b_ptr + offs) 

154 if FP32_PROMOTE: 

155 a = a.to(tl.float32) 

156 b = b.to(tl.float32) 

157 tl.store(out_ptr + offs, tl.minimum(a, b)) 

158 else: 

159 mask = offs < num_elems 

160 a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs, mask=mask) 

161 b = tl.load(b_ptr + offs, mask=mask) 

162 if FP32_PROMOTE: 

163 a = a.to(tl.float32) 

164 b = b.to(tl.float32) 

165 tl.store(out_ptr + offs, tl.minimum(a, b), mask=mask) 

166 

167 

168def _minimum_grid(numels, fixed_grid, block_size): 

169 """The grid is always a multiple of the tensor count: every tensor gets the same number of parts. 

170 

171 ``(tensor, part)`` linearization requires ``num_programs % NT == 0``; otherwise tail tensors 

172 lack a part and the tile loop striding by ``num_parts`` skips blocks nobody covers 

173 (``_foreach_flat._fused_grid`` with a 24 grid carrying a 16-tensor list measured half the 

174 tensors losing their odd tiles, see the ``_foreach_maximum_List`` comparison record). 

175 Here divisibility holds by construction. 

176 ``numels`` is the element-count list the caller already materialized for the metadata, so the 

177 per-call host path does not walk the tensor list a second time. 

178 """ 

179 num_tensors = len(numels) 

180 blocks_per_tensor = triton.cdiv(max(numels), block_size) 

181 parts = max(1, min(fixed_grid // num_tensors, blocks_per_tensor)) 

182 return (num_tensors * parts,) 

183 

184 

185def _cached_scalar_tensor(scalars, device): 

186 """The ScalarList fp32 scalar table (read-only), cached by (device, value tuple).""" 

187 key = (str(device), tuple(scalars)) 

188 cached = _SCALAR_CACHE.get(key) 

189 if cached is not None: 

190 return cached 

191 if len(_SCALAR_CACHE) >= SCALAR_CACHE_LIMIT: 

192 _SCALAR_CACHE.clear() 

193 cached = torch.tensor(scalars, dtype=torch.float32, device=device) 

194 _SCALAR_CACHE[key] = cached 

195 return cached 

196 

197 

198def _run_minimum_cached(self, operand, mode, inplace): 

199 """Lean single-launch path for the three operand forms (metadata goes through the read-only cache). 

200 

201 Inapplicable forms return ``FALLBACK`` and the caller picks the fallback target: broadcast 

202 ``.List`` needs ``run_binary``'s per-tensor kernel; the rest fall back to the shared executor. 

203 The four metadata segments (input/output/second-operand addresses plus element counts) match 

204 ``_foreach_flat``'s fused kernel layout exactly. 

205 

206 Paired ``.List`` goes through ``_minimum_list_kernel``: BLOCK is tiered by dtype (fp32 8192, 

207 16-bit 16384) before deciding ``EXACT`` mask-free; when any tensor element count does not 

208 divide the chosen BLOCK the whole table falls back to 8192 + mask, matching the historical 

209 shipped behavior. 

210 """ 

211 if not can_use_flat(self, operand, mode): 

212 return FALLBACK 

213 num_tensors = len(self) 

214 in_ptrs = [tensor.data_ptr() for tensor in self] 

215 outputs = self if inplace else [_EMPTY_LIKE(tensor) for tensor in self] 

216 out_ptrs = in_ptrs if inplace else [tensor.data_ptr() for tensor in outputs] 

217 numels = [tensor.numel() for tensor in self] 

218 dtype = self[0].dtype 

219 triton_dtype = _TL_DTYPES[dtype] 

220 device = self[0].device 

221 

222 if mode == MODE_LIST: 

223 # Reuse the element counts already collected above instead of re-walking both lists. 

224 if not all(other.numel() == numel for other, numel in zip(operand, numels)): 

225 # Broadcast .List does not share flat indices with the inputs, so hand it to the per-tensor kernel. 

226 return FALLBACK 

227 b_ptrs = [other.data_ptr() for other in operand] 

228 meta = _device_meta(in_ptrs + out_ptrs + b_ptrs + numels, device) 

229 if USE_EXACT and dtype is not torch.float32: 

230 block = BLOCK_SIZE_16BIT 

231 else: 

232 block = BLOCK_SIZE 

233 if USE_EXACT and all(numel % block == 0 for numel in numels): 

234 exact = 1 

235 else: 

236 block = BLOCK_SIZE 

237 exact = 0 

238 grid = _minimum_grid(numels, FIXED_GRID, block) 

239 _minimum_list_kernel[grid]( 

240 meta, 

241 num_tensors, 

242 triton_dtype, 

243 FP32_PROMOTE, 

244 block, 

245 exact, 

246 num_warps=NUM_WARPS, 

247 num_stages=NUM_STAGES, 

248 ) 

249 elif mode == MODE_SCALAR_LIST: 

250 if USE_SCALAR_CACHE: 

251 scalar_tensor = _cached_scalar_tensor(operand, device) 

252 else: 

253 scalar_tensor = torch.tensor(operand, dtype=torch.float32, device=device) 

254 meta = _device_meta(in_ptrs + out_ptrs + [0] * num_tensors + numels, device) 

255 grid = _minimum_grid(numels, FIXED_GRID, BLOCK_SIZE) 

256 fused_binary_scalar_kernel[grid]( 

257 meta, 

258 scalar_tensor, 

259 num_tensors, 

260 OP_MIN, 

261 triton_dtype, 

262 0, 

263 triton_dtype, 

264 0.0, 

265 1, 

266 FP32_PROMOTE, 

267 BLOCK_SIZE, 

268 num_warps=NUM_WARPS, 

269 num_stages=NUM_STAGES, 

270 ) 

271 else: 

272 meta = _device_meta(in_ptrs + out_ptrs + [0] * num_tensors + numels, device) 

273 grid = _minimum_grid(numels, FIXED_GRID, BLOCK_SIZE) 

274 fused_binary_scalar_kernel[grid]( 

275 meta, 

276 self[0], 

277 num_tensors, 

278 OP_MIN, 

279 triton_dtype, 

280 0, 

281 triton_dtype, 

282 float(operand), 

283 0, 

284 FP32_PROMOTE, 

285 BLOCK_SIZE, 

286 num_warps=NUM_WARPS, 

287 num_stages=NUM_STAGES, 

288 ) 

289 return None if inplace else outputs 

290 

291 

292def _dispatch(self, operand, mode, inplace, fallback): 

293 """Lean single-launch path first; broadcast/anomalous forms fall back to shared semantics.""" 

294 if FALLBACK_TO_PUBLIC: 

295 return fallback() 

296 if USE_META_CACHE: 

297 result = _run_minimum_cached(self, operand, mode, inplace) 

298 if result is not FALLBACK: 

299 return result 

300 if mode != MODE_LIST: 

301 # can_use_flat failed: leave dtype policy and exception semantics to the common executor. 

302 return fallback() 

303 result = run_binary( 

304 self, 

305 operand, 

306 OP_MIN, 

307 mode, 

308 inplace, 

309 fixed_grid=FIXED_GRID, 

310 block_size=BLOCK_SIZE, 

311 num_warps=NUM_WARPS, 

312 num_stages=NUM_STAGES, 

313 use_device_context=USE_DEVICE_CONTEXT, 

314 fp32_promote=FP32_PROMOTE, 

315 fused=FUSED_LAUNCH, 

316 ) 

317 if result is FALLBACK: 

318 return fallback() 

319 return result
